summary: You store a thumbs up or down tied to the request id (checked for existence, comment hidden for private strings), compute an SLI against an SLO with an error budget, and let the numbers send you to a fix: one cold start made the SLI 95% against a 99% objective, and a warm-up at start took the first request from 3447 and 596 ms to 42 and 34 ms.
goal: Add a thumbs up or down and store it.

items.text: Add feedback.py, the endpoint and its tests, and send a vote for an id that exists and one that does not
Send about eight votes and write the query that shows each down-vote with its question
Compute your SLI by hand from the requests table and say whether your SLO is met
Add the warm-up at start and measure the first request with it off and on, twice each
Play the SLI and SLO game to the end and see your score
